name: @kickside/storage-s3-ui
title: S3 storage
description: Settings component owned by the optional kickside/storage-s3 extension.

wippy.description: Admin settings component for the optional kickside/storage-s3 module, mounted declaratively by its Settings block. It reads only its own policy and destination endpoints through the authenticated host API. Administrators can keep processed files local or select a configured S3 destination and folder prefix, verify upload/download/delete, save and apply the policy, or reset future placement. Existing attachments and Knowledge references remain stable. No caller-supplied properties or custom events are required.
